column3: Decision note: CUA hover is a standalone unpressed-movement op that never restores the pointer (restoring dismisses popups) and grants no cross-call application ownership; arrival order and session lifetime establish no priority (27 lines, Problem/Decision/Alternatives/Consequences).
Simplified-Chinese counterpart of the continuous-hover note, structurally parallel (same 27 lines, same four sections, same cross-links), adding that the system-pointer path serves disabled controls.
Per-heading-section hash record for the hover-routes note (en/zh pairs for 5 sections) with the re-record command in the header; fences and generated regions excluded from the hash.

Decision note: AX alternate-UI hover route before system pointer; model coordinates are screenshot pixels by default or integer thousandths 0-1000 on request, converted once by the Host; LlmAdapter.imageRequestTarget is the single source of provider image geometry.
Simplified-Chinese counterpart of the hover-routes note (29 lines, parallel structure), naming the mouse-hit-test exclusion of transparent overlays and the provider/Host split of geometry duties.
Per-heading-section hash record for the team-identity note (5 sections), with only sections that still hold language-specific content carrying an entry.

Decision note: teammate identity moves from the initial task into a required systemPrompt.context() contribution re-rendered from current membership; the loop re-admits the whole runtime-context snapshot after compaction only when it changed; supersedes only the initial-task identity decision of the earlier Agent Teams note.

Simplified-Chinese counterpart of the team-identity note (31 lines, parallel), spelling out that a fork from a teammate may inherit a stale role and that optional-context suppression cannot remove a required identity.
Per-heading-section hash record for the webworker note; 11 entries because the note nests five sub-headings under Decision, and nested heading paths make a 16.8 KB note reviewable section by section.

Long decision note (105 lines): the browser Preview must boot the same profile composition the served web deployment boots (roster read from app-boot's PROFILE_TEMPLATES+OPTIONAL_BUNDLES, platform differences confined to one home-patch row, parity measured as 1 differing row of 188); Node internal-module shims are interfaces-only; Inspector degrades only on ERR_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE_ON_PLATFORM; lazy chunks are split per require.async literal into deterministic lazy/<sha256>.tar.gz archives fetched on first async read, with sync access refused via ERR_DSH_VFS_DEFERRED and the digest explicitly not verified.

Simplified-Chinese counterpart of the webworker note (105 lines, parallel, same symptom/cause table and same measured MiB figures), detailing the layer-ordering defect (bundle layers applied before the profile patch, so base rows do not yet exist).
